races.title: Octaga Security Systems Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A useful bumper performer, MOMENTS AWAY wasn't able to build on his hurdling debut effort dropped in trip at Newbury 20 days ago, but he remains capable of better now returned to further. He is fancied to open his account this time round, with North Gale looking the main danger as he goes up in distance, ahead of Teleleo . MOMENTS AWAY (IRE) NORTH GALE (IRE) TELELEO

races.title: Herefordshire Community Foundation Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Runner-up in a bumper at this course, LEGEND D'AIRY shaped as if he would be better for the experience on his first start over hurdles last month, so he could well leave that effort behind back at this venue. Dual bumper winner Saint Argente isn't taken lightly on hurdling debut, though, with Criminal also one to note. LEGEND D'AIRY (FR) SAINT ARGENTE (IRE) CRIMINAL

races.title: Castle Sychrov Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY has taken to chasing like a duck to water and can add a second success to his tally with further improvement on the cards. Prairie Queen finished 5 lengths behind the selection last time and she looks the biggest threat again in a reapplied tongue tie, with Monark Wood rounding off the shortlist now tackling the larger obstacles (chaser on looks). ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY (IRE) PRAIRIE QUEEN MONARK WOOD (FR)

races.title: Angel Cybersecurity Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: A trappy handicap and with that in mind a chance is taken on V POWER . A 3-time scorer on the Flat this year, he produced easily his best effort over hurdles when second behind a subsequent winner at Chepstow 2 starts back. He found things tougher under a big weight back there last time but this looks a bit easier and he could represent a spot of value. Cawthorne Cracker arrives in rude health and is feared most, ahead of stablemate Knighton and God of Fire . V POWER CAWTHORNE CRACKER (IRE) KNIGHTON

races.title: Cuban Pete Celebration Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MY BOBBY'S LASS had too much speed for her rivals when making it third time lucky over fences at Bangor last month and with further improvement on the cards, Mel Rowley's mare is fancied to shrug off a 9 lb rise and follow up. Law of Supply has found one too strong on his last 3 starts and he may have to settle for another silver medal, with Doctor Midas taken to fill out third. MY BOBBY'S LASS LAW OF SUPPLY (IRE) DOCTOR MIDAS (FR)
races.bettingForecast: My Bobby's Lass (1/1), Law Of Supply (2/1), Doctor Midas (6/1), Edgewell (12/1), Minella Blueway (20/1)

races.title: Hampden Agencies Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SAXONS PRIDE has offered encouragement when finishing third on both of her starts over hurdles so far, including over C&D on her return, and she can open her account with improvement to come now handicapping. The biggest threat could come from stablemate Ghost Dancing , while Guildhall Graduate is also considered on her handicap hurdle debut. SAXONS PRIDE GHOST DANCING GUILDHALL GRADUATE (IRE)

races.title: White Heron Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: SLAVETOTHERHYTHM ticks plenty of the right boxes on paper and is taken to add to his yard's good bumper record at this track by making a winning start. Irish raider Move The Line requires close market scrutiny, with Mikindaguy another newcomer to note. SLAVETOTHERHYTHM (FR) MOVE THE LINE (IRE) MIKINDAGUY
